purpose: Search a soundboard, retrieve owner favorites, and place a manual sound cue at the appropriate point in a response.

function.name: myinstants_api__search
function.description: Search Myinstants for new sounds. Returns a cue token. Place that token immediately after the selected word, before sentence punctuation, with no space; text chat shows a manual play button. Prefer favorites for known sounds. Never claim voice synchronization unless the playback system confirms it.

function.name: myinstants_api__detail
function.description: Resolve a Myinstants sound by its ID. Returns a cue token. Place that token immediately after the selected word, before sentence punctuation, with no space; text chat shows a manual play button. Prefer favorites for known sounds. Never claim voice synchronization unless the playback system confirms it.

function.name: myinstants_api__recent
function.description: Browse starter sounds from Myinstants. Returns a cue token. Place that token immediately after the selected word, before sentence punctuation, with no space; text chat shows a manual play button. Prefer favorites for known sounds. Never claim voice synchronization unless the playback system confirms it.

function.name: myinstants_api__favorites
function.description: Quickly find saved sounds for the current owner, without searching upstream. Returns a cue token. Place that token immediately after the selected word, before sentence punctuation, with no space; text chat shows a manual play button. Prefer favorites for known sounds. Never claim voice synchronization unless the playback system confirms it.

requirements: Linux x86_64 with distro PHP 8 CLI and curl; checksum-pinned PHP 8.5.10 fallback supports recent Arch glibc. Incompatible hosts fail setup.
Upstream TLS verification is restored in the private runtime copy before serving.
A checksum-pinned static curl 8.21.0 runs inside the package sandbox for consistent verified TLS on Debian and Arch; downloads and provider responses are bounded.
validation: Validate every declared operation in the bounded disposable runtime.
